mapper.sql: select r.receipt_id, r.batch_id, r.buyer_id, r.station_id, r.gas_type, r.qty, r.consumed, r.adjusted, r.received_at, r.version, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, b.batch_no, s.station_name, bu.buyer_name, (r.qty + r.adjusted - r.consumed) as remain from gas_purchase_receipt r left join gas_purchase_batch b on r.batch_id = b.batch_id left join gas_station s on r.station_id = s.station_id left join gas_buyer bu on r.buyer_id = bu.buyer_id
mapper.select: select r.receipt_id, r.batch_id, r.buyer_id, r.station_id, r.gas_type, r.qty, r.consumed, r.adjusted, r.received_at, r.version, (r.qty + r.adjusted - r.consumed) as remain from gas_purchase_receipt r where r.receipt_id = #{receiptId} for update

select r.receipt_id, r.batch_id, r.buyer_id, r.station_id, r.gas_type, r.qty, r.consumed, r.adjusted, r.received_at, r.version, (r.qty + r.adjusted - r.consumed) as remain from gas_purchase_receipt r where r.station_id = #{stationId} and r.gas_type = #{gasType} and (r.qty + r.adjusted - r.consumed) > 0 order by r.received_at, r.receipt_id for update
mapper.insert: insert into gas_purchase_receipt( batch_id, buyer_id, station_id, gas_type, qty, received_at, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{batchId}, #{buyerId}, #{stationId}, #{gasType}, #{qty}, #{receivedAt}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(qty + adjusted - consumed), 0) from gas_purchase_receipt where batch_id = #{batchId}
